subject.title: fix(canvas): bound A2UI JSONL file reads

question: Should `GatewayClient` enforce `hello-ok.policy.maxPayload` locally for every serialized request, rather than limiting this check to the Canvas A2UI path?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility boundary in a shared transport used beyond Canvas; source review can verify implementation mechanics but cannot choose the desired client-wide failure behavior.

options.title: Accept the shared transport contract
options.body: Merge with the policy check applying to every GatewayClient request, so oversized frames fail locally before a socket send.

options.title: Scope the limit to Canvas
options.body: Move payload budgeting to the Canvas invocation path if maintainers want other GatewayClient callers to retain the prior server-side failure behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared transport contract
recommendation.body: Merge with the policy check applying to every GatewayClient request, so oversized frames fail locally before a socket send.

likelyOwner.reason: RileyJJY is the only non-author review participant identified in the supplied PR timeline after the shared Gateway scope was introduced.
